g.text: ClinicBook - Class diagram (availability and booking, Dajana Bardhi)
+findOverlappingForPatient(patientId : int, start : DateTimeImmutable, end : DateTimeImmutable) : Appointment[]
Only BOOKED occupies a slot and counts towards FR-05.
Rules checked in order; first failure wins.
Clock is injected so 24 h / 90-day rules are testable.
